description: SynthSeg label maps against the FreeSurfer 8.1.0 goldens, and soft volumes (mri_synthseg --vol) against FreeSurfer 8.2.0's tables. exes/synthseg/tests/parity.rs, the package's pipeline test, the app's fixture e2e and validation/cli-check.mjs all read these gates; the tissue map gates are read by exes/synthseg/tests/parity.rs and validation/compare.mjs. maxQuaternionError is exclusive; the other limits are inclusive.

tissues.description: GM, WM and CSF maps against their own label map and soft volumes; no FreeSurfer golden exists for them. A tissue total passes within either volume limit: the soft volumes are rounded to 0.001 mm³ and the header affine is float32.
